name: chevron-up
description: A balanced upward chevron with straight arms and a rounded vertex in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: The fill-only contour is the exact union of the Regular 1.70 stroke exterior, with radius-.85 free-end caps. Straight edges, internal intersections and any rounded outer joint are constructed analytically from the Outline centerline. Line marks have no enclosed body or counter to fill; both styles intentionally retain the same recognizable mark at Regular. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70 are the reference. Round 3 draft awaiting owner review.
